name: Dicey Bizniz
storyline:
In Dicey Bizniz, players take on the role of a daring gambler who enters a high-stakes underground dice circuit where every roll influences fate and fortune. In a world where skill, luck, and strategy intertwine, competitors harness mystical relics, spells, and enchanted dice to rise through the ranks of ever-escalating challenges known as "antes".

As the protagonist delves deeper, the mysterious Dragon Sanctum offers powerful upgrades that bind their destiny to the dice themselves, blurring the line between chance and control. Each game run represents a new bid for success in this calculated gamble of fate, testing the player's ability to master probability, adapt strategy, and thrive in the perilous business of chance.
summary: A strategic dice roguelike where you build powerful combinations by locking and rerolling dice to beat escalating score targets. Collect game-changing relics, cast tactical spells, and master probability through 11 challenging antes.
